headline: Heavy Rains Trigger Multiple Landslides Across South Jakarta Areas
seoTitle: Landslides Reported in Multiple South Jakarta Locations
metaDescription: Heavy rainfall has caused multiple landslides in South Jakarta, damaging residences and prompting intervention from the provincial government.
aiSummaryBullets: Severe rainfall triggered multiple landslides across Mampang Prapatan, Pasar Minggu, and Kemang districts in South Jakarta.
Five homes in the Kemang area sustained damage after a local parking facility collapsed, affecting eight families.
Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung has ordered the immediate construction of retaining walls to stabilize affected areas and prevent further occurrences.
aiContextParagraph: On November 11, 2026, severe weather conditions resulted in several landslides throughout South Jakarta. The incidents impacted residential neighborhoods in Mampang Prapatan, Pasar Minggu, and Kemang. In Kemang Selatan, authorities reported damage to five houses, reportedly linked to the collapse of a parking area at a sports facility. In Pasar Minggu, landslides obstructed drainage systems, requiring emergency cleanup operations by local officials. While no fatalities were reported, the events displaced thirty individuals across eight households. Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung has directed regional agencies to oversee emergency repairs and implement infrastructure projects, specifically the construction of retaining walls, to mitigate future risks in vulnerable zones. Clean-up efforts involving emergency services and public works personnel are currently underway across all affected sites to clear debris and secure residential structures near the damaged terrain.
whyItIsViral: The event has generated significant news coverage across major Indonesian outlets due to the simultaneous nature of the landslides and the prompt official response from the Jakarta Governor.
